name: Pathways for Future Engineers (Virginia Tech)
what_you_do: A Virginia Tech engineering program for students who would be the first in their family to go to college. It runs two-week summer programs with team design projects and lab work. It also gives college application help and campus visits.
who_can_apply: Virginia residents entering grade 10, 11 or 12. You must be a first generation college student. That means neither parent graduated from a four year college in the U.S. or abroad.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the program pages. Ask pathways@vt.edu.
duration: Up to 2 weeks (2026: June 14 to 27 for rising seniors, June 21 to 27 for rising 10th and 11th graders)
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was May 31, 2026. Camps ran in June 2026. No 2027 dates are posted.
how_to_apply: Send in the Pathways application linked on the page. Contact Perry Martin at pathways@vt.edu with questions.
notes: Only for Virginia residents who would be first generation college students. Dates are from 2026. The pages do not say whether the summer program is free. The eligibility text on the page mentions students entering grades in the fall of 2025, so it may be out of date. Check the application link before you plan.
